FN-H7ND863-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 150
Committee: Finance and Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/19/2024
Senate Bill 150 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Department of Revenue to
promulgate rules and regulations to implement and administer the provisions of this bill
requiring accommodations intermediaries to collect and remit the lodgings tax when facilitating
a transaction and to report certain information to the Department.
Page 1

FN-H7ND863-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 150
Committee: Finance & Taxation General Fund Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/20/2024
Senate Bill 150 as reported by the Committee on Finance and Taxation General Fund would
require: 1) accommodation intermediaries to collect transient occupancy tax from
accommodation providers; and 2) both parties to submit annual reports to the Department of
Revenue. This bill could also increase the obligations of the Department of Revenue to
promulgate rules and regulations to implement and administer the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

FN-H7ND863-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 150
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/15/2024
Senate Bill 150 as passed the Senate would require: 1) accommodation intermediaries to collect
transient occupancy tax from accommodation providers; and 2) both parties to submit annual
reports to the Department of Revenue. This bill could also increase the obligations of the
Department of Revenue to promulgate rules and regulations to implement and administer the
provisions of this bill.
